title: Compressible Neo-Hookean finite-strain release contract
purpose: Freeze the constitutive energy, nominal stress, Jacobian, and displacement-controlled finite-element patch that underlie the porous-cell release workflow.

execution.evidence: The material-point energy gradient and a homogeneous finite-element patch are checked independently; the full porous-cell workflow remains a manual release regression.

observables: Principal first-Piola stresses for a versioned triaxial stretch state.
Strain-energy density and positive deformation Jacobian.
Convergence and imposed displacement in a homogeneous finite-element patch.
acceptance: The analytical nominal stress equals a centered derivative of stored energy.
Every versioned observable satisfies the Golden tolerances.
The finite-element patch converges without a non-positive Jacobian.

quantities.name: principal_nominal_stress
quantities.description: First-Piola principal stresses for stretches [1.2, 0.9, 1.05], E=2 MPa, and nu=0.3.

quantities.name: strain_energy_density
quantities.description: Compressible Neo-Hookean stored energy for the versioned stretch state.

quantities.name: deformation_jacobian
quantities.description: Positive volume ratio for the versioned stretch state.

limitations: This is an implementation and release contract, not external experimental validation.
The two-dimensional convenience path is plane strain; plane stress requires a local thickness solve.
The full imported periodic-cell mesh remains a manual regression because of runtime and external-data size.
